limits: Includes all candidate changes and zone refills, not exclusively the added BAT_TS trace.
Rectangle projections exclude track end caps, pads, vias and 3D coupling.
USB comparison uses 0.025 mm margin, a geometric screen rather than an impedance acceptance criterion.
No continuity graph, reference-via inductance, field solution or physical measurement.
Any newly uncovered signal needs review even with DRC zero.
